controls.label: Orbit radius
controls.serializedMeaning: Horizontal radius of the one proximity path.
controls.causalObservation: Card centre x range changes while camera-distance response, source order, phase, and source pixels remain unchanged.

controls.label: Proximity strength
controls.serializedMeaning: Strength of bounded nonlinear near swell and amount of travel time reserved for near approach/departure.
controls.causalObservation: At identical story time near-card scale and local phase distribution change coherently; far identity/order and global duration do not.
controls.ownershipReason: Defines the Scene's distinctive near/far physics.

controls.label: Path projection
controls.serializedMeaning: Coupled vertical projection and camera-depth amplitude of the path.
controls.causalObservation: Vertical near/far separation, geometric perspective, alpha, and depth ordering change from one path coordinate; horizontal phase/order do not.
controls.ownershipReason: Controls spatial projection rather than Look lighting.

controls.label: Card size
controls.serializedMeaning: Base card width before source ratio and deterministic near collision cap.
controls.causalObservation: Card bounds and cap activation change while centre path, phase, and source ratio stay fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Sets readable density for this spatial path.
